headline: Kyrgyzstan wants to merge benefits and other state payments into a single system
summary: Kyrgyzstan plans to create a unified digital system for assigning and transferring state payments to citizens. A draft government resolution on the project has been prepared.
why: State benefit disbursement systems determine how public transfers reach households and how government spending is administered.
original_headline: В Кыргызстане пособия и другие госвыплаты хотят объединить в одну систему
